structure.unit: Personal Representatives and Administration of Estates

law.catch_line: Construction of direction to pay all taxes imposed on account of testator's death

text.section: Unless a contrary intention is manifest, such taxes shall be apportioned and charged to each item of funds or property generating them in the manner provided in this article.
The reference in subsection A to any section or chapter is to the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, and shall be deemed to refer to any corresponding successor sections, chapters, or Code.
